settings.heading: Welcome to the club that rewards good habits.
settings.text: Free to join. Earn points when you buy, review and return empties, then spend them on products, discounts and in-store services.
settings.image_alt: Smiling woman in a yellow dress on a salt flat
settings.tiers_heading: Spend more in a year, unlock more.

settings.text: Sign up with an email and password; in-store and online orders link to the same account.

settings.title: Collect
settings.text: Points come from purchases, reviews, returned empties and following us on social.

settings.title: Choose
settings.text: Redeem for products, money off, services or a seat at member events.

settings.heading: Give $25, get $25
settings.text: Your friend must be a first-time shopper. Your credit arrives after their first purchase, and codes can't be combined.

settings.label: Do I lose my level?
settings.text: Levels follow the last twelve months of spending, counted from the day you qualified. Drop below the line and you step down; points stay.

settings.label: Where do I use my rewards?
settings.text: At the register in a boutique, in the club page online, or at the foot of your bag.

settings.label: How do I get the free facial?
settings.text: Bloom members book online or ring a boutique; the session is on us once per year.

settings.label: Why didn't my review earn points?
settings.text: Only one review per hour counts, and reviews must be of products you bought from us.

settings.heading: Join the list
settings.message: New brands, member offers and boutique events by email or text, twice a month.
